decision: Retain the validated offline component. Next qualify pre-ingestion availability, full scheduling, native reservations, original per-study budgets, shared429 policy and study migration before a live proposal.
falsifier: Missing or rewritten original attempts, mismatched raw/index or service evidence, fabricated timely availability, unreported transports, incorrect budget discounts, or failure of independent archived reproduction invalidates the relevant contract claim.
hypothesis: A versioned public collector ledger can preserve original local admissions and API-return/raw evidence while distinguishing authenticated transports from deferrals and unresolved work.
limitations: Actual-producer lineage is recorded after original ingestion/recovery; pre-ingestion enforcement is not implemented by this harness.
Only synthetic SNDK candles and empty headers are exercised through all five frozen implementations; no latency or financial benchmark.
Native full scheduler and durable reservation are not exercised; per-study budgets and full-loop cancellation/restart/migration remain unqualified.
Shared429 cooldown creates local deferrals and requires an explicit adoption policy; original independent collectors remain unchanged.
HTTP response availability is not market-data completeness; a durable start is not proof of wire arrival or venue charging.
Unkeyed hashes and trusted local clocks are integrity evidence, not protection from compromised local writers.
100 percent measured statement/branch coverage applies only to the five new candidate modules, not the complete system or all possible behaviors.
